text.room.ferry_landing.title: Ferry Landing
text.room.ferry_landing.description: Reeds crowd a slick wooden landing. A [mooring post](mooring_post) leans into the current.
text.room.village_green.title: Village Green
text.room.village_green.description: An old elm shades a patch of trodden grass.
text.detail.mooring_post: Rope has worn a groove into the post. Someone has carved a fox into it.
text.npc.bram.description: A ferryman with rope-scarred hands and a coat that has never been dry. He keeps the landing by day and goes up to the green at dusk.
text.narration.coil_rope.actor: You coil the wet rope around the post, slowly, the way Bram does it.
text.item.lantern.room: A [brass lantern] sits on a coil of rope.
text.item.lantern.description: Dented brass, still smelling of oil. It would light a fen path.
text.quest.lantern.title: Bram's lantern
text.dialogue.bram.prompt: Bram looks at the lantern, then at the reeds. "Are you coming with us, or do you mean to go along the bank yourself?"
text.dialogue.bram.leave: Leave it with the search party
text.narration.bram.carry: You keep the lantern. Bram nods once and points you down the bank.
text.narration.bram.leave: You hand Bram the lantern. He lifts it toward the reeds and calls the others in.
